title: Stress-Testing International Eval Methodologies for Language Sensitivity

original_idea.body: Stress-Testing International Eval Methodologies for Language Sensitivity

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: language-dependent safety evals undermine eval reliability used to gate deployment; explicit and defensible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open multilingual model + translated prompts + automated scoring on a single GPU; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment with a clear cross-lingual variance metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reproducible open-model probe extending a Network finding; no lab resources.

low_compute.reasoning: Small open model inference on one GPU; modest compute.

novelty.reasoning: Multilingual safety variance noted; a focused refusal-rate-by-language probe may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Language sensitivity noted; focused open-model characterization may be open.
